resources.string: In-app plugins
Built-in viewers and file tools
Included with Atomic
These features are built into the app and updated with Atomic. No separate installation is needed.
Built in
Version v%1$s
Back to plugins
Features
Current limitations
Open a matching file from Files to use this feature. Use Open with another app in the preview for other viewers.
Image viewer
Browse images, swipe through a gallery, zoom and pan. Photo orientation is applied automatically.
Format support depends on the decoder. Very large images use a reduced preview. Image editing is not included.
Video player
Play, pause, seek and adjust playback speed with the built-in media player.
Audio player
Play, pause and seek audio, with available track metadata.
Codec support depends on the device. Playback pauses when leaving the app. Remote preview copies are limited to 512 MiB.
PDF reader
Read PDF pages, zoom, jump to a page and retry a failed load.
Page images only. Text search, selection, forms, annotations and password unlocking are not included.
Document reader
Read DOCX text with headings and basic structure, select text, find words and adjust text size.
Read-only text preview. Original page layout, embedded drawings, document editing and legacy DOC files are not supported.
Code and text editor
Read and edit text with line numbers, wrapping, find and replace, and saves that preserve encoding and line endings.
File-size limits apply. Unsaved drafts survive screen recreation but not app process termination. Code execution and IDE tools are not included.
Markdown viewer
Switch between source and rendered text with headings, lists and code blocks.
Supports a basic Markdown subset. Complex extensions may display as plain text.
Archive manager
Browse supported archives, extract files and create ZIP archives with file-operation progress.
Available actions and password support depend on the archive format. Damaged or unsafe archives may be rejected.
